subject: MAP Kickoff & Evaluation Plan — Lumina Health POC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.l@luminahq.com>, Miguel Torres <m.torres@luminahq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff & Evaluation Plan — Lumina Health POC

Hi Sophie / Miguel —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to put a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and evaluation kickoff in one place so we can align on owners, success criteria, and the timeline to reach a go/no-go decision. Our goal is to finish the POC evaluation in four weeks and produce a short scorecard that maps performance to your acceptance criteria.

Quick overview (high-level):
- Scope: Integrations for customer support summarization and search re-ranking across two representative workflows (chat transcripts and knowledge base search).
- Duration: Apr 7 — May 5 (4 weeks) with a checkpoint at two weeks.
- Success criteria (proposed): latency <= 300ms p95 for single-turn generation (document summary), embedding similarity recall >= 0.82 on your benchmark set, and no data retention beyond session per policy.

Owners (proposed):
- Lumina success owner / product: Sophie Lambert (validation & evaluation sign-off)
- Lumina technical lead: Miguel Torres (data slices & infra access)
- Redwood sales / POC lead: Karthik Iyer (overall MAP coordination)
- Redwood tech lead: Vivek Kulkarni (benchmark execution & infra)
- Redwood PM: Laura Bennett (acceptance criteria mapping / scorecard)

Immediate asks:
1) Sophie — confirm the proposed success criteria and whether you want to add any compliance checkpoints (e.g., HIPAA data handling confirmation).
2) Miguel — share the two representative datasets and a sample of the KB (s3 link or shared drive) by Apr 9 so we can prep the benchmark harness.
3) All — pick a 30-minute weekly sync cadence. I propose Wed 10am PT starting Apr 14.

I attached a draft MAP (Lumina_MAP_v1.pdf) and a benchmarking template (benchmark_template.xlsx) we will populate together.

If this looks good, I'll post the MAP to the shared Drive and update the HubSpot timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: Lumina_MAP_v1.pdf; benchmark_template.xlsx
From: Sophie Lambert <sophie.l@luminahq.com>

Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@luminahq.com>, Anita Goyal <anita.goyal@healthdata.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff & Evaluation Plan — Lumina Health POC

Thanks Karthik — this looks great and clean. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: agree to the latency and embedding recall targets but would like to add model token-efficiency as a soft metric (our budget team asks for a target cost per 1k tokens; can you suggest what to expect?)
- Compliance: HIPAA yes — we need a short attestation/one-pager that outlines our shared responsibilities and retention behavior. Anita (cc) will be our security reviewer.
- Data: Miguel will drop the KB sample and the anonymized chat transcripts into the shared Drive by Apr 9 EOD.
- Cadence: Wed 10am PT works. If the Redwood ops run any long-standing tests that might look like traffic anomalies, please flag us in advance.

Action: I'll review the MAP and confirm acceptance of the scorecard structure by Apr 10.

Sophie
Head of Product, Integrations
Lumina Health

Perfect — thanks Sophie. A couple of quick updates and clarifications after internal sync: 

- Cost proxy: for the initial benchmarking runs, expect approximately $1.10 per 1k tokens processed for gen + embedding combined at our hosted tier baseline. We'll refine after we measure batch sizes and prefix caching. Marissa will own cost telemetry and post-run estimates.
- HIPAA attestation: Aditya is preparing a short responsibilities note; we'll add that to the MAP and tag Anita for review.
- Drive links: Miguel — once you drop the samples, Vivek will run the benchmark harness over the weekend and post preliminary latency/embedding results Monday morning.

Planned checkpoints:
- Apr 14 (Wed) 10:00 PT — weekly sync #1, objectives: confirm sample ingestion, agree on exact eval script, lock final success thresholds.
- Apr 21 (Wed) 10:00 PT — checkpoint #2, objectives: interim results and any model/config rollout decisions.
- Apr 28 (Wed) 10:00 PT — internal Redwood demo / scorecard draft.
- May 5 — final decision/go-no-go and next steps.

I attached the MAP draft to this message and created a pre-populated sheet in the benchmark template naming the owners. See attachments and the Drive doc link.

Thanks — Karthik

Hi Miguel —

Quick technical note as we prepare the harness:
- Please provide the KB as a CSV with columns {doc_id, title, body, last_updated}. For chat transcripts a JSONL per conversation with messages ordered is ideal. Anonymize PHI fields and replace with placeholders.
- If you have expected query traffic shapes (percent of short vs long queries, typical token lengths), include that — it helps us tune batching and prefix caching.
- We will run two benchmark variants: 1) latency-focused (single-turn gen, lower batch sizes) and 2) throughput-focused (batched requests for nightly re-rank jobs). We'll share the sample run logs in the Drive.

I will kick off the weekend run once the files land; expect initial numbers Mon morning.

Vivek
Tech Lead, Redwood Inference
